issue: Secrets committed to repository (GEMINI_API_KEY, DATABASE_URL, API keys)
repro_steps: Open backend/.env in repository and inspect values.
suggested_fix: Rotate/revoke exposed keys; remove backend/.env from repo; add to .gitignore; use secret manager; provide backend/.env.example.

issue: Arbitrary code execution risk: execute_code_locally runs user code without sandboxing; execute_code_via_piston silently falls back to local execution when Judge0 not configured.
repro_steps: Call POST /api/code/execute-raw or /api/code/run with code that reads files or performs network requests when Judge0 unset; observe host-side effects.
suggested_fix: Disable local execution fallback in production; require ALLOW_LOCAL_EXECUTION opt-in; use an isolated runner or containerized sandbox; enforce auth and rate limits.

issue: /api/code/execute-raw accepted arbitrary files and executed them without auth, rate-limits or size caps.
repro_steps: POST a Python file containing system calls or large payload to /api/code/execute-raw and observe execution.
suggested_fix: Require API key; add rate limiting and payload size limits; reject execution when Judge0 not configured; return 503 when execution unavailable.

issue: API key handling used plain equality and defaulted to empty string; misconfiguration returned 500; non-constant-time compare.
repro_steps: Unset API_SECRET_KEY and call protected endpoint -> returns 500; probe for timing differences when validating keys.
suggested_fix: Fail fast when API_SECRET_KEY missing; use hmac.compare_digest for constant-time comparison; return 401 for invalid keys.

issue: Multiple issues: undefined variables when saving submits (mcqAnswers/codingSubmissions), unsanitized LLM translation and hinting, DDL auto-migrations in request path.
repro_steps: POST /api/assessment/submit with normal payload -> server error; invoke translation/hint with large code -> LLM call; call endpoints with restricted DB role -> migration DDL may fail.
suggested_fix: Replace undefined variables; enforce input size limits and sanitize before LLM calls; move migrations to Alembic/startup job.

issue: Similarity threshold misconfigured (SIMILARITY_THRESHOLD=1.3) and no retry/backoff on embedding calls.
repro_steps: Call retrieve_context() and observe empty or incorrect results; revoke GEMINI key and observe unhandled exceptions.
suggested_fix: Confirm metric scale and set appropriate threshold; add try/except and retry/backoff; add cached fallback.

issue: Model client uses global api_key and returns model outputs with little sanitization; errors expose misconfiguration.
repro_steps: Call RAG endpoints with missing/invalid key and observe exceptions; model may return code fences unsafely.
suggested_fix: Centralize model client creation with robust error handling; sanitize outputs; add provenance metadata.

issue: Fragile result comparisons: direct stdout==expected equality is brittle to whitespace and canonicalization.
repro_steps: Provide test where expected is 'Hello' and actual 'Hello\n' -> marked failed.
suggested_fix: Normalize outputs before comparison: trim, normalize newlines, JSON-compare where applicable; add per-language normalization.

issue: Embeddings computed locally with heavy model (SentenceTransformer); resource-intensive and unbounded.
repro_steps: Run embedding script on large corpus -> high memory usage and potential OOM.
suggested_fix: Run embedding generation in controlled batch workers; or use managed service; add batching and error handling.

issue: Crawler writes files following relative links without path normalization; no robots.txt handling.
repro_steps: Crawled page with crafted paths could write outside intended directory.
suggested_fix: Resolve and validate href paths; ensure output path is a child of output_dir; respect robots.txt; cap depth/rate.

issue: Parses HTML and writes JSON; may retain HTML-derived text that could be rendered unsafely (XSS) if later used with innerHTML.
repro_steps: Parse malicious HTML and later render in frontend using dangerouslySetInnerHTML -> XSS.
suggested_fix: Store plain-text only, escape HTML, or ensure frontend sanitizes before rendering; avoid dangerouslySetInnerHTML.

issue: Deletes and recreates ChromaDB collection unconditionally (data loss risk) and inserts items one-by-one (inefficient).
repro_steps: Run script -> old collection removed; slow insertion for large dataset.
suggested_fix: Use atomic create-and-swap, batch inserts, and backup collection before deletion.

issue: In-memory cache not thread/process-safe (no locks) and lacks eviction policy; unsafe in multi-worker deployments.
repro_steps: Concurrent requests calling topic_cache.set/get may race; multi-process deployments lose cache state.
suggested_fix: Add threading.Lock around operations or use Redis; add max entries and LRU eviction.

issue: Connects to ChromaDB and prints documents without error handling; may leak data.
repro_steps: Run script in production -> prints dataset to stdout/log.
suggested_fix: Avoid printing sensitive data; add try/except; restrict script to admin use.

issue: Uses dangerouslySetInnerHTML to inject generated CSS variables; could be abused if config values are untrusted.
repro_steps: If chart config contains attacker-controlled values, malicious CSS may be injected.
suggested_fix: Validate/sanitize color tokens; whitelist accepted values; ensure config cannot be user-controlled.

issue: Custom markdown renderer implemented safely (no dangerouslySetInnerHTML).
suggested_fix: Continue to avoid rendering raw HTML; consider more features if needed.

issue: Third-party dependencies present; repo contains committed virtualenv and build artifacts.
repro_steps: Inspect repo -> backend/scraper/venv and dist/ directories present.
suggested_fix: Remove venv and dist from repo; add to .gitignore; run npm audit and pip-audit; remediate CVEs.
